items.text: Tampa Bay: LB Yaya Diaby (Grade 2 MCL) out at least one game, likely multiple weeks. WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) TBD. On IR: WR Jalen McMillan, LB Christian Rozeboom, CB Josh Hayes. Baker Mayfield starts.

Chicago (TBD): DT Kentavius Street (knee, carted off Monday), DT Grady Jarrett (groin), CB Malik Muhammad (toe), RB Kyle Monangai (toe/thumb, out since Week 4). TE Cole Kmet (season), S Coby Bryant, DE Dayo Odeyingbo (Week 11) on IR. DT Jeffery Simmons debuted Monday.
